text:
kevin: Heads up — seeing ~35% drop in tokens/sec for CTB on main after today's deploy. Baselines from last week were stable. Quick profiler dump below. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Deployed commit abc1234 -> main at 1965432000. Canary 10% promoted at 1965432050.

kevin: Local snapshot (1k reqs, seq=16k, 4xA100 staging):
```
tokens/sec: 18.2k (was 28.1k pre-deploy)
avg_queue_time_ms: 22.7 (was 4.1)
avg_inflight_batches: 6.3 (was 3.9)
memcopy-host->device calls increased by ~2.8x
```

jon: CI perf shows same trend, p95 latency up and token throughput down. Dash: https://perf.internal/redwood/ctb/1965432 (graphs attached).

anya: Can bisect range abc1000..abc1234. I can run a binary-search deploy today if we want fast root cause.

marie: Note — kernel-autoselect change landed in abc1200. It adjusted kernel choice heuristics to prefer the new fp16 kernel path with a different memcopy layout. Could be a regression in kernel->memcopy ordering.

kevin: Minimal strace/tracepoint dump showing unexpected cudaMemcpy frequency: 
```
[ctb_worker] step=1023 cudaMemcpy H2D size=524288 (caller=kernel_dispatch.cpp:412)
[ctb_worker] step=1024 cudaMemcpy H2D size=524288 (caller=kernel_dispatch.cpp:412)
[ctb_worker] kv_lookup hit 0.73 -> triggered host staging path
```

sre-ci: Reproduced on dedicated staging (4xA100). Queueing backlog increased after abc1200: queue_time median 4ms -> 20ms, p95 48ms. Batch distribution skewed to smaller effective batch sizes (more small batches).

jon: Quick microbenchmark that toggles kernel hint to legacy path shows tokens/sec back to ~27.5k. Command used: `./bench_ctb --kernel-hint=legacy --iters=10000`. Results: restored latency and throughput.

anya: Suggest hold/promote revert for abc1200 until we patch selector. I'll prepare a revert PR and run canary on staging.

marie: Alternative: patch kernel selector to prefer 'kv-friendly' path when predicted_kv_hitrate > 0.6. I have a local patch that switches memcopy ordering and reduces host staging. Perf locally looks good.

kevin: For triage: 1) bisect confirmed abc1200 correlates 2) quick legacy hint restores throughput 3) queue_time and extra cudaMemcpy point at memcopy ordering in kernel path.

jon: I'll attach perf traces (flamegraphs) to the ticket: s3://redwood-perf/ctb/flames/1965432100/ and a short comparison screenshot.

marie: :+1: Patch + unit test for selector added to my branch, will run CI perf. If green, we can patch instead of full revert.

kevin: Revert PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/3421. Canaries at 5% now, monitoring. :rocket:

sre-ci: Canary observing: tokens/sec climb back to 26-28k, queue_time median dropping to ~5ms. Will watch 30m window.

anya: Good catch. Once canary stable we should add a perf test that exercises kv cache hit patterns to prevent regressions.

kevin: Agreed. I'll follow up with a minimal repro script and add to perf suites. Thanks all. :tada:
